summary: Aggregation queries support the sum and avg functions.
extended_definition: Aggregation queries support the sum and avg functions.

supporting_pages.title: Aggregation queries \_|\_ Datastore \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Firestore in Datastore mode supports the following aggregation queries: count() sum() avg() Aggregation queries simplify your application code and cost less than fetching each entity for processing.
Pricing Pricing for the count() , sum() , and avg() aggregation queries depends on the number of index entries scanned during the operation.
